major_batting_records.title: Highest ODI Score
major_batting_records.description: Scored 264 runs against Sri Lanka in 2014, the highest individual score in ODI cricket.

major_batting_records.title: ODI Double Centuries
major_batting_records.description: The only player in cricket history to score three ODI double centuries.

major_batting_records.title: Most World Cup Centuries
major_batting_records.description: Scored five centuries in the 2019 ICC Cricket World Cup.

major_batting_records.title: Most International Sixes
major_batting_records.description: Holds the record for hitting the most sixes across international cricket.

major_batting_records.title: T20I Centuries
major_batting_records.description: First male player to score five centuries in Twenty20 Internationals.

captaincy_and_team_success.title: T20 World Cup 2024
captaincy_and_team_success.description: Led India to victory in the ICC T20 World Cup and retired from T20I cricket after the tournament.

captaincy_and_team_success.title: Champions Trophy 2025
captaincy_and_team_success.description: Guided India to victory in the ICC Champions Trophy.

captaincy_and_team_success.title: IPL Success
captaincy_and_team_success.description: Captained Mumbai Indians to five Indian Premier League titles.

awards_and_honors.description: Awarded India's prestigious civilian honor for his contribution to cricket.

awards_and_honors.description: Named ICC ODI Cricketer of the Year.
